summary: Vodafone Group Plc filed a Form 6-K reporting capitalization at March 31, 2026, and disclosed the May 5, 2026 agreement to buyout CK Hutchison Group Telecom Holdings Limited's 49% interest in VodafoneThree Holdings Ltd for £4.3 billion ($4.9 billion) cash. The transaction is implemented via cancellation of CKHGT's shares, making Vodafone the sole owner. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or expected close date were stated. Watch for regulatory clearance and any related financing arrangements.
